WEB_SHP_009: PASSES 2026-09-09. Under posture enforce:true, with clearance outstanding for MAH 5413868000009 (INV-20260909-000027), the dispatch was refused with "Error Shipping blocked by unpaid invoices. Outstanding cents: 5600" - a refusal that names the billing reason, so it is the gate and not some unrelated failure. THIS REVERSES AN EARLIER VERDICT. It was recorded fail on 2026-09-08 against a bug claiming Enforce never blocks; that bug has been retracted and deleted. Re-reading the invoice timeline showed the two 2026-09-08 escapes both dispatched within seconds of their clearance being raised, while every observation against aged clearance is a clean refusal. The gate works; what does not is its blindness to clearance billing has not swept into an invoice yet, which is now WEB_SHP_012 and carries the re-scoped bug. The case was also rebuilt to suit: it establishes and reads back a non-zero balance before shipping, because the platform gates on the MAH balance ("Outstanding cents: N") rather than on the consignment, and because matching a per-import invoice is impossible while folding is in effect.
